title: Getting the Source Right, Not Just the Fact: Source-Aware Verification for MCP Agents
summary: This work addresses verification for MCP (Model Context Protocol) agents, arguing that checking factual correctness alone is insufficient—agents must also verify the provenance and trustworthiness of sources. It proposes source-aware verification methods to help agents assess where information originates, improving reliability and reducing risks from untrusted or manipulated data in tool-using LLM systems.
